level_1: Performs components of basic complexity procedures
level_2: Performs basic complexity procedures
level_3: Performs moderate complexity procedures and recognizes intra- operative complications
level_4: Performs high complexity procedures and manages intra- operative complications
level_5: Independently performs high complexity procedures

subcompetencies.name: Patient Evaluation and Clinical Decision Making

level_1: Identifies patient specific factors needed to design a diagnostic work-up and surgical plan for a basic complexity procedure
level_2: Integrates information with patient specific factors to design a succinct diagnostic work- up and surgical plan for a basic complexity procedure
level_3: Integrates information with patient specific factors to design a succinct diagnostic work- up and surgical plan for a moderate complexity procedure
level_4: Integrates information with patient specific factors to design a succinct diagnostic work-up and surgical plan for a high complexity procedure
level_5: Formulates an approach for complex patients who do not fit into traditional algorithms

level_1: Interprets diagnostic data for a critically ill patient
Performs high complexity bedside procedures
level_2: Performs basic complexity bedside procedures
Implements a comprehensive treatment plan for peri- operative patients with high complexity procedures
level_3: Implements a treatment plan for peri-operative patients with basic complexity procedures
Performs high complexity procedures in urgent scenarios and determine need for emergent surgical intervention
level_4: Performs moderate complexity bedside procedures
Implements a comprehensive treatment plan for a patient condition that does not have clear guidelines
level_5: Implements a treatment plan for peri-operative patients with moderate complexity procedures
Teaches moderate complexity procedures to junior learners

level_1: Demonstrates comprehension of and explains morphology for basic complexity congenital cardiac defects
level_2: Demonstrates comprehension and applies knowledge of morphology for moderate complexity defects
level_3: Demonstrates comprehension of morphology for higher complexity defects and distinguishes between different morphologies
level_4: Demonstrates comprehension and integrates knowledge of morphology for most complex defects and uncommon or rare variants
level_5: Teaches morphology for complex defects to junior learners

level_1: Demonstrates basic comprehension of pathophysiology and surgical outcomes of basic complexity defects, including timing of repair
level_2: Demonstrates general comprehension of pathophysiology and surgical outcomes of moderate complexity defects, including timing of repair
level_3: Demonstrates detailed comprehension of pathophysiology and surgical outcomes of higher complexity defects, including timing of repair
level_4: Demonstrates in-depth comprehension of pathophysiology and surgical outcomes of most complex defects and uncommon or rare variants
level_5: Teaches pathophysiology and surgical outcomes of complex defects to junior learners

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of common patient safety events
Describes local quality improvement initiatives
Participates in disclosure of patient safety events to patients and families (simulated or actual)
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of how to report patient safety events
Participates in analysis of patient safety events (simulated or actual)
Demonstrates the skills required to identify, develop, implement, and analyze a quality improvement project
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of basic quality improvement methodologies and metrics
Reports patient safety events through institutional reporting systems (actual or simulated)
Actively engages teams and processes to modify systems to prevent patient safety events
level_4: Identifies system factors that lead to patient safety events
Participates in local quality improvement initiatives
Role models or mentors others in the reporting/disclosure of patient safety events to superiors/organization
level_5: Reports patient safety events to superiors/ faculty members
Conducts analysis of patient safety events and offers error prevention strategies (simulated or actual)
Creates, implements, and assesses quality improvement initiatives at the institutional or community level

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of care coordination
Identifies specific population and community health needs for their local population
Role models and advocates for safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs within and across health care delivery systems
level_2: Identifies key elements for safe and effective transitions of care and hand-offs
Coordinates care of patients in complex clinical/social situations effectively using the roles of the interprofessional teams
Adapts personal practice to provide for the needs of specific populations
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of population and community health needs
Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in complex clinical situations
Analyzes the process of care coordination and leads in the design and implementation of improvements
level_4: Coordinates care of patients in routine clinical/social situations effectively using the roles of the interprofessional teams
Uses local resources effectively to meet the needs of a patient population and community
Improves quality of transitions of care within and across health care delivery systems to optimize patient outcomes
level_5: Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in routine clinical situations
Role models effective coordination of patient- centered care among different disciplines and specialties
Leads innovations and advocates for populations and communities with specific health care needs

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems

level_1: Identifies key components of the healthcare system (e.g., hospital, finance, personnel, technology)
Discusses the impact of component selection on overall costs
level_2: Understands the mechanisms for reimbursement, including types of payors
Discusses various components of the health care system to provide efficient and effective patient care and transition of care
level_3: Recognizes the components of how a health care system are inter-related, and its impact on patient care
Makes cost effective decisions
level_4: Recognizes the impact of component selection on overall costs
Advocates for systems change that enhances high-value, efficient, and effective patient care and transition of care
level_5: Understands how individual practice affects the broader system (e.g., length of stay, readmission rates, clinical efficiency)
Participates in health policy advocacy activities

level_1: Demonstrates how to access and use available evidence to take care of a routine patient
level_2: Articulates clinical questions and elicits patient preferences and values in order to guide evidence-based care
level_3: Locates and applies the best available evidence, integrated with patient preference, to the care of complex patients
level_4: Critically appraises and applies evidence even in the face of uncertainty and conflicting evidence to guide care, tailored to the individual patient
level_5: Coaches others to critically appraise and apply evidence for complex patients; and/or participates in the development of guidelines

subcompetencies.name: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth

level_1: Accepts responsibility for personal and professional development by establishing goals and actively seeking opportunities to improve
level_2: When prompted, uses performance data to identify gaps, design, and implement a learning plan
level_3: Independently uses performance data to identify gaps, design, and implement a learning plan
level_4: Independently uses performance data to measure the effectiveness of the learning plan and adapt the plan as needed
level_5: Facilitates the design and implementation of learning plans for others

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of the ethical principles underlying informed consent, surrogate decision making, advance directives, confidentiality, error disclosure, stewardship of limited resources, and related topics

level_3: Recognizes need to seek help in managing and resolving ethical situations

level_1: Recognizes the need to complete administrative tasks and responsibilities
